transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you—what has been bothering you lately that made you decide to come in today?

Lately my mood has been all over the place, mostly feeling really “up” and then suddenly getting irritated or angry over the smallest things. It’s starting to cause problems with people around me, and I feel like I can’t really control it anymore.

During these “up” periods, do you also notice needing much less sleep, feeling unusually confident or driven, or doing things that are risky or out of character for you (like overspending, impulsive sex, or sudden big plans)?

Yeah, when I’m in those “up” phases I sleep maybe 3–4 hours and still feel wired, like I don’t need rest. I feel really confident and driven, start a bunch of projects at once, and I’ve definitely spent too much money on things I don’t really need, but I haven’t done anything like risky sexual stuff.
Have you also had periods lasting at least two weeks where you felt very down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, with low energy or loss of interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I’ve had stretches like that, where for weeks I just feel really down most of the day and nothing feels enjoyable. It’s been happening on and off for over a year, and during those times my energy is really low and I feel kind of empty or numb.

During your most “up” phases, have your symptoms ever become so intense that you needed to go to the hospital or were unable to function at work or in daily life, or have they stayed noticeable but still manageable without hospitalization?

I haven’t gone to the hospital, but there have been times I probably should have, because I was barely functioning. I’ve stayed up almost all night for days, talking nonstop and jumping from task to task, and it got bad enough that I missed work and had big blow‑ups with people because I was so irritable and agitated.

When you have these most intense “up” phases where you’re barely functioning and missing work, how long do they usually last from start to finish—are we talking about several days, or at least a full week or more at that high level?

The really intense “up” parts usually last at least a week, sometimes a couple of weeks before they ease up a bit. But overall this high, wired kind of state has been going on for around 8 months without ever really going back to what I’d call normal.

During your most intense “up” phases, have you ever had experiences like hearing or seeing things that others don’t, or strongly believing things that others say aren’t true (for example, feeling you have special powers or a special mission)?

I don’t think I’ve ever seen or heard things that weren’t there. Sometimes I feel like I have this big, important purpose or that I’m meant to do something huge, but I still kind of know it might be over the top and I can be talked out of it.

During your most intense “up” or “down” periods, has your thinking ever become so disconnected from reality that others said you were talking nonsense or you couldn’t be reasoned with, or have you always been able to recognize that your thoughts might be exaggerated or unrealistic when people challenge you on them?

People have told me I was talking so fast and jumping between ideas that they couldn’t follow me, but not that I was completely talking nonsense. Even when I’m really “up” or really low, if someone pushes back I can usually step back a bit and realize I might be going overboard or not thinking totally realistically.
Right now, over the past month or so, would you say you’ve mostly been in a high/wired state, mostly depressed, or has your mood been relatively stable without clear episodes in either direction?

In the past month I’ve mostly been in that high, wired state. I still have some dips where I feel down and kind of empty, but the “up,” irritable, over‑energized side has definitely been more prominent.

Before these past 8 months of feeling mostly high and wired, did you ever have clear, separate episodes in earlier years where you felt similarly “up” for at least several days at a time, with periods of feeling more or less back to your usual self in between?

I don’t really remember having clear “up” episodes like this before these past 8 months. I’ve had times when I was more energetic or in a good mood, but nothing this intense or obviously different from my normal self.
